19065.ins: Chiffon bodysuits run best hand-washed in cold water and hung to dry - machine agitation is what shortens their life. The open construction means no fastenings to fuss with; it is on or it is off, and nothing in between needs managing.
19065.short: Chiffon Catwoman jumpsuit with built-in open-crotch cut, one size for 40-60 kg, single-piece costume in as-pictured colorway.
19065.td: Open-crotch chiffon jumpsuit in Catwoman styling, as pictured. One size for 40-60 kg, single-piece costume lingerie with fitted line.

19109.ins: The veil is the piece that photographs - it catches light and movement in a way the mesh itself does not. Breeze, a fan, or a doorway turn are all it takes. Between uses, flat storage keeps the lace from creasing along the mesh lines.
19109.short: Sheer mesh bride set with top, skirt and veil for role-play occasions, one size fitting 40-60 kg, as pictured in lace.

19149.ins: Milk silk handles a matchday the way costume polyester cannot: it breathes through extra time and penalties alike, and it washes back to shape overnight. The bandeau stays put through jumping, which is the real test of cheering apparel.
19149.short: 2024 DE football cheering set with bandeau top and shorts in breathable milk silk, one size 90-155 lbs, bonus socks included.

19153.ins: For group viewing parties, the FR and DE sets from this collection pair as a two-side order - same fabric, same cut, different allegiance. The relaxed fit means the set also survives being worn as summer loungewear long after the tournament ends.
19153.short: 2024 FR football cheering set with bandeau top and shorts in breathable milk silk, one size 90-155 lbs, tournament socks included.

19157.ins: Patent leather jumpsuits want a wipe-down after wear and storage away from direct heat - radiators and car dashboards are the two usual culprits. The zipper runs smoother with an occasional dry-lube if it stiffens after a season in storage.
19157.short: Black patent leather anime queen jumpsuit with full functional front zipper, one size for 90-155 lbs, wipe-clean shine.

19185.ins: Three sizes rather than one is the practical argument for this listing over the one-size police sets: patent leather shows a wrong fit immediately, and the tie adjusts only so far. Order the closer band if you sit between two.
19185.short: Black patent leather policewoman set with top, skirt and tie in three real sizes S to L by weight, 40-65 kg fit.

19188.ins: Lace washes best in a lingerie bag on gentle, or by hand if the machine lacks one - the collar piece especially, since its shape is the costume. Line drying keeps both pieces at their original length, which is where the fit lives.
19188.short: Plus-size lace maid set with collar and dress in two true sizes, M for 40-55 kg and L for 55-70 kg, as pictured.

19189.ins: Between the two colorways the cut is identical, so the choice is purely register: white for the reference look, black for something that reads as evening wear outside the costume context. The veil works for photographs in both.
19189.short: Bridal chiffon set with veil, top, skirt and sleeves in white or black, one size for 40-60 kg, four coordinated pieces.

19208.ins: The wings store best hanging rather than folded - a hanger hook through the collar keeps them shaped for next October. Leather top and panties wipe clean, which matters for a costume that earns its wear on one loud night a year.
19208.short: Black little devil costume with leather top, structured wings and matching panties in open-chest cut, one size for 40-60 kg.

19235.ins: The waist seal does more than the photos suggest - it defines the silhouette the way an obi would, and it keeps the robe from falling open in wear. The vintage print hides wrinkles well, making this a forgiving travel costume.
19235.short: Vintage print chiffon kimono set with waist seal and matching underwear, one size for 40-70 kg, wide bust range.
